Fee Structure: Most personal injury lawyers work on a contingency fee, meaning they charge no upfront fees and only take a percentage if they recover money for you. Karns and Karns +2
Statute of Limitations: Under California Code of Civil Procedure § 335.1, you generally have two years from the date of the accident to file a personal injury lawsuit. If a government vehicle or dangerous public road condition is involved, a much shorter six-month deadline may apply under Government Code § 911.2. Mirador Law +3
Comparative Fault: California follows a pure comparative negligence rule. You can still recover compensation even if you were partly at fault, though your total award is reduced by your percentage of fault. Stephen M. Fuerch +2
